content:
Thomas Braziel, the lawyer planning to bring a @Coinkite suit, is already lying to COLDCARD victims.

After raised concerns as reported by the WSJ, Braziel claims that "the matter was ultimately settled, allowing the receivership to move forward, monetize the remaining assets, and deliver an exceptional outcome for shareholders."

According to court filings, this is untrue.

Court documents show Braziel was removed from the receivership and the court reserved the right to bring further proceedings against him.

Please, if you can, get into the Telegram group and alert the COLDCARD victims of who they are dealing with.

Link: https://t.me/coldcardvictims
